statement: For time-sensitive statutory QA, treating temporal validity as a hard constraint (filtering retrieval to the version valid at the query's as-of date) is reported as the effective mitigation, and the retrieved timeframe matters more than the retrieval method.

evidence.quote: existing legal RAG systems should not simply retrieve "relevant" semantic matches but must also take into account the temporal validity of a statute as a hard constraint
what is retrieved (the correct timeframe) matters more than how it is retrieved (embeddings vs. table of contents)
